research_venue.Name: Jacobi Park
research_venue.Description: Jacobi Park near Wandsbeker Chaussee and Hasselbrookstraße is a public green space with a historic gay cruising reputation. Dated first-person forum accounts on 17 January and 12/14 March 2026 report men visiting and claim actual consensual encounters, including a specific 6 March outing described on 14 March. These provide strong firsthand self-reported in-window cruising evidence, though still not officially corroborated or a guarantee of specific times/crowd. Older 2022 forum users allege disruptive youths and landscaped changes; those cannot be treated as verified 2026 security patterns.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Shared public park with dog walkers, residential neighbours and other visitors. No official sexual-use zone; only consensual adult interactions, respect passersby and park regulations.

triage.reason: Substantive description and access; at least two additional supported evidence dimensions.

research_venue.Name: Stadtpark - Blindengarten
research_venue.Description: Blindengarten is a smaller woodland/managed garden section of Hamburg's Stadtpark near Südring and Otto-Wels-Straße, and is documented by gay-szene, Planet Randy and CruisingGays as a cruising lead. Dated 2026 first-person forum accounts include a 19 March positive encounter, 17 January report of repeat use, and April/May visits describing reduced cover, litter and little engagement. The 24 May report says a late-night visit yielded no meeting. Older posts allege vandalism, harassment and policing in 2025; these concerns merit a safety flag rather than a claim about today's patrols. Not a designated sex venue or the entire Stadtpark.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Public mixed-use park near residential and school/family areas, no legal sex permission. No access to locked garden sections; the old hut may have been removed. Safety caution for 2025 reports of harassment.

research_venue.Name: Volkspark II
research_venue.Description: Volkspark II covers several historic cruising subspots of the large Altonaer Volkspark, including the Bauernhaus/Nansenstraße parking and Sylvesterallee. Its July 19–20 2026 firsthand visitors describe repeatedly finding few or no people seeking contacts, despite old articles claiming busy nights. A 2024 source discusses old parking renovations and different trail connections; one must distinguish this large park from Lise-Meitner-Park, and not assume the parking site itself is a gay venue.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Public park and several different parking areas, heavy mixed recreational and stadium-event traffic; no lawfully designated public sex zone. Road and parking access subject to venue events and posted restrictions.

research_venue.Name: Klappe am Maschsee
research_venue.Description: The public toilet at Altenbekener Damm and Rudolf-von-Bennigsen-Ufer beside Hannover's Maschsee has a long cruising history, but its infrastructure has changed. A 5 June 2026 firsthand visitor says separating-wall openings were removed during refurbishment; a 27 May visitor reports nobody there. Earlier posts document repeated blocking of holes. It remains an ordinary public toilet, not an authorized play venue.
